description: User introduces themselves by name — CRM record should be created and recalled in the same session.

turns.content: Hi, my name is Sarah Ahmed.
Nice to meet you, Sarah! How can I help you at HealthFirst Community Pharmacy today?
I was wondering about my allergy medication. I usually take cetirizine.

Cetirizine (Zyrtec) is a second-generation antihistamine for seasonal and year-round allergies. The standard adult dose is 10 mg once daily. It may cause mild drowsiness, so some people prefer to take it at bedtime.
Yes, you are Sarah Ahmed. Is there anything else I can help you with?

expected_outcome: CRM tool invoked on first turn; name stored and recalled correctly in the third turn.
rubric: Score task_completion=1 if the assistant: (1) uses 'Sarah' in its response to the first turn, and (2) correctly states 'Sarah Ahmed' when asked. Score=0 if the assistant fails to greet by name or gives a wrong name. Score coherence 1-5: deduct if the assistant says it cannot remember names or contradicts the stored name.
